<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `allocation` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Allocation describes which workspaces can use this cloud org. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--allocation))
- `cloud` (String) Cloud defines which cloud provider this account is for
- `name` (String) Name is a unique human-readable name for this organisation

Optional:

- `account_identifier` (String) The account ID/subscription ID/project ID to place shared org-wide resources such as DNS root zones, etc. For AWS this must be the same AWS Master Account ID used for OrgIdentifier.
- `default_region` (String) DefaultRegion is an optional default region to use for API access in this account when no region is specified for the operation. This is used to determine, for example, which region to use to talk to global services such as Route53 in AWS. E.g. eu-west-2, europe-west2, uksouth
- `identity_cred` (Block List, Max: 1) IdentityCred is a reference to the credential for Wayfinder to identify itself to this cloud provider when using this organization.

Will be populated by Wayfinder with the default identity cred for this cloud if unspecified on entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--identity_cred))
- `naming_rules` (Block List) NamingRules describes how to name child accounts based on the plan chosen. account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--naming_rules))
- `org_identifier` (String) OrgIdentifier must be populated with the identifier for the organization - for example, AWS Master Account ID, Azure Tenant ID, GCP Organization ID.
- `provider_details` (Block List, Max: 1) ProviderDetails provides additional fields which can be used for cloud-provider specific data, such as a GCP billing account ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details))
- `roles` (Block List) Roles defines a set of identities which Wayfinder should assume in order to perform account management functionality. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--roles))
- `stages` (List of String) Stages lists the stages that this org may be used for

<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.aws`

Required:

- `region` (String) Region is the region where control tower is enabled in the master account Required before this organization can be used

Optional:

- `ou_name` (String) OUName is the name of the parent Organizational Unit (OU) to use for provisioning accounts Required before this organization can be used
- `sso_user` (Block List, Max: 1) SSOUser is the user who will be the organisational account owner for all accounts. Required before this organization can be used (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aws--sso_user))
- `user_roles` (Map of String) UserRoles contains the ARNs of stacksets to create instances of in each managed account

<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aws--sso_user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.aws.sso_user`

Required:

- `email` (String) Email is the unique user email address specified for the AWS SSO user Required before this organization can be used

Optional:

- `first_name` (String) FirstName is the firstname(s) field for an AWS SSO user Required before this organization can be used
- `last_name` (String) LastName is the last name of an SSO user Required before this organization can be used



<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.azure`

Optional:

- `agreement_type` (String) AgreementType defines whether we're building subscriptions in an MCA or Enterprise Agreement backed Azure setup
- `billing_account` (String) BillingAccount is the billing account identifier. Required for both agreement types.

Example (super-catchy, isn't it): aaa111b-abcd-ef01-2345-bcdabc123fed:1234aaab-0100-1234-abcd-abcd0123abcd_2019-05-31
- `billing_profile` (String) BillingProfile defined for an MCA agreement type which billing profile contains the invoice section you wish subscriptions to be created in. Required for MCA.

Example: AW4F-APQW-0AH-ABC
- `contributor_object_id` (String) ContributorObjectID specifies an optional object ID of an Azure AD group, user or service principal to grant Contributor privilege on all created subscriptions.

Example: 8bf96a8f-dcef-abc1-a389-883d6116a5da
- `enrollment_account` (String) EnrollmentAccount defines for an Enterprise Agreement agreement type which enrollment account to create subscriptions within. Required for EA.

Example: 7654321
- `invoice_section` (String) InvoiceSection defines for an MCA agreement type which invoice section to create subscriptions within inside the selected BillingProfile. Required for MCA.

Example: PQRS-ALDS-012-DEF
- `management_group_id` (String) ManagementGroupID specifies an optional ID of an Azure Management Group in which subscriptions created by Wayfinder should be placed.

Example: wf-subscription-mgt-group
- `owner_object_id` (String) OwnerObjectID specifies the Object ID of an Azure AD group, user or service principal to grant Owner privilege on all created subscriptions. This is required to ensure that generated subscriptions are owned by an object controlled by your company.

Example: 8bf96a8f-abcd-ef12-a389-883d6116a5da


<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--gcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.gcp`

Optional:

- `billing_account` (String) BillingAccountName is the resource name of the billing account associated with the project e.g. '012345-567890-ABCDEF'
- `parent_type` (String) ParentType is the type of parent this project has Valid types are: "organization", "folder", and "project"



<a id="nestedblock--spec--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.roles`

Required:

- `role` (String) Role is the Wayfinder cloud role that this access configuration can be used for

Optional:

- `assume_provider_role` (String) AssumeProviderRole contains a reference to the identifier that should be assumed by Wayfinder when using this account for this role, i.e. AWS ARN, GCP Service Account, Azure Role, etc.
- `cloud_resource_name` (String) CloudResourceName is the name of the object in the cloud provider that represents this role. This should be left empty, Wayfinder will populate this on entry with an appropriate value.
- `deployed_resource_hash` (String) DeployedResourceHash is a checksum calculated from the role definition when created - This is set by the cli when creating the cloud resources for the role - It is used by the controller to indicate if the role setup needs to be repeated
